{{Quote|On Soruus the Despot towers over the arena where many a gladiator has bled out his dreams.|Bleys Harand, ''Travels Amid Strange Stars''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Soruus''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster's]] [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Originally a part of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it was a successful [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world during the reign of [[Cronese]] [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] and was also associated with a tradition of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] spectacles that persisted over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]. The merchant, [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]], and [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Bleys Harand]] at one point visited a [[Soruus gladiatorial arena|gladiatorial arena]] on Soruus in search of a contemporary visual depiction of Xim.

==Description==
Soruus was a terrestrial<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Soruus system/Legends|Soruus system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Soruus lay on the [[Greater Cronese Arc]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], which linked it to the [[Barancar system/Legends|Barancar]] and [[Pasmin system/Legends|Pasmin systems]].<ref name="Xim" />

==History==
{{Quote|He holds a heatbeam in one great fist, but the statue is polysteel, assembled by a factory on Centares during the chancellorship of Kirbat the Unready.|Bleys Harand, ''Travels Amid Strange Stars''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:KingdomOfCron25150BBY-TheHistoryOfXimAndTheTionCluster.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Soruus was part of the Kingdom of Cron.]]
Between approximately [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], Soruus was part of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. After the ascension to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of [[Cronese]] [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]<ref name="Xim" /> in 25,130 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Soruus was incorporated into his wide-ranging [[Xim's empire|empire]] and was a successful [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world. It also gained renown for [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] spectacles, with tradition associated with them surviving the decline of most other local commerce over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="Xim" />

The merchant, [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]], and [[Historian/Legends|historian]]<ref name="Xim" /> [[Bleys Harand]] at one point traveled to the worlds of the Tion Cluster in search of a contemporary visual depiction of Xim. On Soruus,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> he<ref name="Xim" /> visited a [[Soruus gladiatorial arena|gladiatorial arena]] where a [[Unidentified tour guide|tour guide]] reluctantly revealed to him that the venue's statue of Xim was a relatively modern creation. Harand later mentioned Soruus in a travelogue, ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'', he [[Author/Legends|authored]] about his voyage to the Tion.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Locations==
Soruus was the site of a gladiatorial arena. During the [[Chancellor/Legends|chancellorship]] of [[Kirbat the Unready]], a tall [[polysteel]] statue of Xim was manufactured at a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] on<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> world [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] before being erected at the arena.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soruus was first mentioned in the [[December 7]], [[2009]], [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-6.<ref name="Xim" /> Soruus was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned it was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the world was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the StarWars.com [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
